candidates.old:
BMI wrap                        \ the hot path falls through
    STA edge_screen_address_high
    BRA group                       \ 65C02 opcode
.wrap
    EOR #&C0                        \ &80-&82 -> &40-&42: - &40
    STA edge_screen_address_high
    BRA group                       \ 65C02 opcode
.done
    RTS
candidates.new:
STA edge_screen_address_high    \ stored before the test (STA keeps N): a wrapped &80-&82 is mended below
    BPL group                       \ the hot path: N = 0 (A = &40-&7F), straight back
.wrap
    EOR #&C0                        \ &80-&82 -> &40-&42: - &40
    STA edge_screen_address_high
    BRA group                       \ 65C02 opcode
.done
    RTS
    SKIP 2                          \ keeps every later address as it was (no page moves)
candidates.summary: Store the row's high byte before the wrap test and loop on BPL (STA leaves ADC's N alone): the hot path loses the untaken BMI and the BRA, 8 cycles become 6. The wrapped path stores the unwrapped value first and mends it. SKIP 2 after the RTS keeps all later code at its old address.
candidates.equivalence: Hot path (hi = &40-&7F after ADC #2, N=0): old BMI not taken, STA hi, BRA group; new STA hi, BPL taken to group: same hi stored, same registers (A = hi, X, Y untouched), flags dead at group (LDY #0 first). Wrap path (N=1, A=&80-&82): old BMI taken, EOR #&C0, STA, BRA group; new STA stores the unwrapped A, BPL not taken, falls to EOR, STA overwrites it, BRA group: final hi identical. The transient hi (&80-&82) in &86 is read by nothing in between (no instruction between the two STAs; edge_screen_address is not used by any interrupt code: grep shows only game.6502 set_edge/ column code and render.6502). The done exit is before this code and unchanged. Cost on the wrap path rises by 2 (0.77 times a pass measured). BPL group is -0x4A bytes back, in range.
candidates.relies_on: Page crossings: BPL (ends &96B8 before, now &96B6) and group (&9670) are both in page &96, so the taken branch costs 3 with no page penalty (the old BRA likewise). The SKIP 2 after RTS keeps .hist_dst_hi onward at their old addresses (&96BF) so no later table, branch or indexed read moves across a page. Needs STA zp to leave flags unchanged (it does) and edge_screen_address_high to be read by no interrupt (grep: no).
